description: Patch schema for local Chatterbox Turbo text-to-speech with a reference audio prompt.

unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: The pinned FL_ChatterboxTurboTTS node does not expose a duration control; output length follows text and reference prosody.
unmapped_ui_parameters.exaggeration: Turbo exposes temperature, top_k, top_p, and repetition_penalty, not the standard Chatterbox exaggeration control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speed: Turbo exposes no direct playback-speed control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.remove_silence: The pinned Chatterbox node pack does not expose silence trimming in this node.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speech_to_speech_vc: Turbo reference audio is zero-shot TTS conditioning, not two-audio speech-to-speech voice conversion.

output.contract: Return one readable FLAC audio artifact generated by the local Chatterbox Turbo TTS node with a reference audio prompt.
